# Aniket Jamunde

> Freelance Web Developer & Flutter Developer based in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra, India. Builds fast, conversion-ready websites with React & Next.js and cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter — backed by Firebase, Supabase, and Node.js. 25+ projects delivered, 15+ happy clients, 4.9/5 average rating. Available for freelance work across India and worldwide.

## About
Self-taught developer with 3+ years of experience, specializing in Next.js web development and Flutter app development for founders and small businesses. Every project is built with performance and SEO in mind from day one, not bolted on afterward. Backs frontends with Firebase and Supabase so apps stay fast and reliable in production.

Location: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra, India
Availability: Open for freelance projects — India & worldwide
Experience: 3+ years | Projects: 25+ | Clients: 15+ | Rating: 4.9/5
